justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Appropriate AT selection improves function and participation; ATP-specific outcome comparison not studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: RESNA ATP exam plus 1,500 hours experience; moderate cost and time.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in assistive technology clinics, seating programs, and SCI/neuro specialty settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: ATP supports complex rehab technology documentation; CMS recognizes ATP for equipment prescription; reduces inappropriate device denials.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistent demand in AT clinics and CRT programs; required by some equipment suppliers.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients with AT needs value expert device matching.
justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: RESNA ATP is the standard credential for AT vendors (Permobil, Sunrise, Tobii Dynavox) hiring clinical reps.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Consistent demand from complex rehab and AAC manufacturers.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Modest premium; ATP is often a requirement for industry roles rather than a bonus.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Develops practical fluency across mobility, AAC, EADL, and sensor-based AT.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: One of the most established clinical-to-industry credentials in AT/medtech.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Reasonable cost relative to industry recognition.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Complex rehab tech (wheelchairs, AT) is overwhelmingly insurance/Medicaid-funded; minimal cash-pay.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: ATP is required for supplier billing in many states — leverage is regulatory, not premium-pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: RESNA ATP is distinctive among clinicians and is a gatekeeper credential for seating clinics.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Seating clinic model exists but is supplier-dependent and margin-thin.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't seek ATPs directly; referrals flow through physicians and case managers.
justifications.business.efficiency: Single exam, modest cost — efficient to obtain.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized in OT/PT academia for AT/seating coursework, particularly in OT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: RESNA conference community produces some scholarship; not a major research engine.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Valuable for teaching wheelchair seating, AT, and accessibility content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Seating/AT evidence is moderate, with growing outcomes literature.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred for AT-focused faculty lines, especially OT.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Single exam path makes it an efficient academic credential add-on.
